title: Kummer Bar Resolution
statement: On the existing equivariant internal bar model, define its explicit full simplex diagram and exact point pullback of its nonnegative resolution. Transport the bar derived localization to the published small module-derived localization by its universal property. Resolved bar data includes the actual forgotten injective resolution, all normalized internal-Hom term components, and the finite-total comparison normalized on every coprojection. The resulting column map is universal parameter evaluation, and the total comparison uses the existing normalized invariant augmentation. Built from [def-sfb-kummer-resolution-columns], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Uses [def-sfb-kummer-parameter-evaluation]. Uses [def-sfb-condensed-point-pullback-comparisons]. Uses [def-sfb-profinite-coefficient-linearization]. The two existing internal-Hom presentations are identified by the unique natural isomorphism whose actual evaluation counits agree after the canonical tensor quotient and braiding. Its existence and uniqueness, included here as the presentation law, determine this transport; the derived column map then composes its ordinary derived image with ProfiniteFunctions.comparisonApp.
